user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve Centre County census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a census-tract dataset covering Centre County for the containment join.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census-tract dataset covering Centre County. Treat the result as a candidate and retain its returned metadata for runtime suitability inspection.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to EPSG:26918
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital points from EPSG:4326 to the census-tract CRS so the spatial join has compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector dataset from its observed CRS to EPSG:26918. Preserve all hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Normalize census-tract CRS to EPSG:26918
workflow_steps.purpose: Ensure the retrieved census-tract candidate uses the same CRS as the reprojected hospitals before the spatial join.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved census-tract candidate to EPSG:26918 after runtime verification of its source CRS. Preserve the tract identifier attributes and polygon geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join and attach the containing tract identifier to each hospital.
workflow_steps.instructions: Spatially join the hospital points to the census-tract polygons using containment. Preserve each hospital feature and its attributes, and attach the tract identifier field selected from the observed census-tract schema at runtime. Do not guess field names; runtime QC must ground the hospital identity and tract identifier fields from the actual schemas.

requirements.scope: Retrieved census-tract candidate must cover Centre County.
The retrieved census-tract candidate must have a known source CRS before reprojection.
The census-tract candidate must be available in a format accepted by the reprojection worker.
Hospital points and census-tract polygons must use compatible CRS metadata for the binary spatial join.
Both spatial-join inputs must contain valid, non-empty geometries.
The joined output must retain each hospital record and include the census-tract identifier grounded from the retrieved tract schema.
